titlestmt.titleproper: A Guide to the Rockefeller Family Fund records FA1271

profiledesc.creation: This finding aid was produced using ArchivesSpace on 2026-10-18 12:06:12 UTC.
profiledesc.langusage: Description is written in: English, Latin script.

physdesc.extent: 356 letter document boxes, 3 legal document boxes, 1 half-letter document box, and 37 bound volumes.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research with select records restricted as noted. Board of Trustees records, grants, and staff office records 20 years old and older are open for research. Annual reports are open for research without restriction.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Original order, as received. Arranged in series by file type.
Series 1: Annual Reports. Series 2: Board of Trustees records. Series 3: Grants. Series 4: Staff Office records. Series 5: Audiovisual materials.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The bulk of the Rockefeller Family Fund records is comprised of grant administration files. The collection also includes annual reports, Board of Trustees meeting and associated committee records, and a small selection of office files, staff meetings, correspondene, reports, memoranda, and associated audiovisual materials.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Enhanced Access - Level 2: Multi-Level access. Many materials remain in original housing.

physdesc.extent: 37 bound volumes of unique content. Some reports have multiple copies.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Published annual reports. Some individual reports have multiple copies.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Board records 20 years old and older are open for research.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Records include meeting agendas and minutes, board books and briefing materials, reports, communications between staff and the Board, and records of Board committees including the Finance Committee.

physdesc.extent: 309 letter document boxes, 3 legal document boxes, and 1 half letter document box.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Grant records 20 years old and older are open for research.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Grant administration records include: grant actions, reports, assessments, associated records, and products produced by grantees.
